name: tinywan/workerman-event-poll
description: Workerman 5.x event loop driver based on the PHP 8.6 Io\Poll API, with symfony polyfill support for PHP 8.1+

suggest.symfony/polyfill-time: Only needed if you pin symfony/polyfill-io-poll to 1.x-dev on PHP < 8.6 (provides Time\Duration)
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required by Workerman on POSIX systems
suggest.ext-posix: Required by Workerman on POSIX systems
